description:
## 1.1.0

* **Smooth gallery thumbnails** (new) — replaces the per-tile ExoPlayer+GL thumbnail pipeline with a direct MediaMetadataRetriever decode; removes the gallery memory spikes/stutter.
* **Disable license check** — neutralizes PairIP so a re-signed build launches.
* **Configurable bitrate tiers** — LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH become 25/50/75% of the encoder ceiling (~40/80/120 Mbps at 1080p30).
